They kept a special session open for two years, pushed it through with early voting already underway in last year's governor's race, and failed to publish it three months before an election.

They wrote an extremely misleading ballot question, also in violation of the law, that claimed creating a 10D-1R map was a "temporary measure" to "restore fairness," in order to influence a pa

You truly can't make up what an insane grift the SPLC was running by funding actual hate groups in order to raise money to smear normal conservative organizations as hate groups.

The demand for racism in America continues to outpace the supply.


U.S. Department of Justice (@TheJusticeDept)

🚨HAPPENING NOW: Justice Department announces indictment against Southern Poverty Law Center ("SPLC"). Our indictment alleges SPLC secretly funneled MORE THAN $3 MILLION in funds to members of white supremac

The idea that the new Virginia maps will be "temporary" is the biggest crock of shit. There's going to be four new Democrat members of Congress if this thing passes. The idea that they're just going to voluntarily give up power in six years out of the goodness of their hearts is about as trustworthy as a 'u up' text from Eric Swalwell.


Governor Abigail Spanberger (@GovernorVA)

🗳️Election Day, Virginia!
 Virginia’s redistricting referendum is a temporary, targeted response to what we’ve seen i
Fairfax County could potentially have control of five congressional districts in Virginia after today unless you get out and VOTE NO.

BREAKING: A Fairfax County Judge is sending 19-year-old illegal alien Israel Flores Ortiz to jail for only 135 days for sexually assaulting ten girls in a high school.

His defense attorney at the sentencing hearing today ridiculously tried to justify it by invoking the false allegations that have been made against President Trump.

He also said that his brain "was not fully developed enough" to know that you shouldn't sexually assault people.

Reminder that Abigail Spanberger said this in August of 2025.

Redistricting ended up being the first bill she signed into law a few months later.

VOTE NO.
